content.text: ---search entire backend for github.com in build files---

observation.command: grep -rn "GITHUB_TOKEN\|maven.pkg.github\|github.com" backend --include="*.kts" --include="*.gradle" --include="*.properties" --include="*.toml" --include="*.versions.toml" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---search entire backend for github.com in build files---"; find backend -name "*.gradle*" -o -name "*.kts" | xargs grep -ln "github" 2>/dev/null
